booking_events_reschedule_check.name: booking_events_reschedule_check
booking_events_reschedule_check.value: (event_type = 'rescheduled') = (from_starts_at is not null) and (event_type = 'rescheduled') = (to_starts_at is not null)

bookings_period_check.name: bookings_period_check
bookings_period_check.value: ends_at > starts_at and ends_at - starts_at <= interval '4 hours'

bookings_kind_columns_check.name: bookings_kind_columns_check
bookings_kind_columns_check.value: (kind = 'appointment' and doctor_id is not null and specialty_id is not null and visit_type is not null and exam_type_id is null and public_code is null and lane is null) or (kind = 'exam' and doctor_id is null and specialty_id is null and visit_type is null and exam_type_id is not null and public_code is not null and lane is not null and status in ('confirmed', 'cancelled', 'completed'))

bookings_cancellation_check.name: bookings_cancellation_check
bookings_cancellation_check.value: (status = 'cancelled') = (cancelled_at is not null and cancelled_by_role is not null) and (cancelled_at is null) = (cancelled_by_role is null) and (status = 'cancelled' or (not late_cancellation and cancel_reason is null)) and (cancelled_by is null) = (cancelled_by_role is null or cancelled_by_role = 'system') and (cancelled_by_role is distinct from 'doctor' or cancel_reason is not null)

unit_hours_period_check.name: unit_hours_period_check
unit_hours_period_check.value: 0 <= open_min and open_min < close_min and close_min <= 1440

doctor_schedule_ranges_period_check.name: doctor_schedule_ranges_period_check
doctor_schedule_ranges_period_check.value: 0 <= start_min and start_min < end_min and end_min <= 1440

password_reset_tokens_one_open_per_user_.name: password_reset_tokens_one_open_per_user_key
password_reset_tokens_one_open_per_user_.where: used_at is null and revoked_at is null

password_reset_tokens_single_outcome_che.name: password_reset_tokens_single_outcome_check
password_reset_tokens_single_outcome_che.value: used_at is null or revoked_at is null
